notes: DONE: 3260 unique URLs, 31/31 days (09-30=163, 10-10=75, 10-20=135, min 33 on 10-25), ~9 fresh requests / ~53s. Route: robots.txt 200 (permissive for our UA; only /wp-admin/ and */embed/ disallowed) names https://observador.pt/wp-sitemap.xml, a WordPress core sitemap index with 244 numbered post sitemaps wp-sitemap-posts-post-N.xml, 2000 URLs each, strictly ordered by <lastmod> ASCENDING (oldest first; file 1 is 2014, file 240 ends 2026-08-22, file 244 ends 2026-10-26). The script binary-searches the index for sitemaps whose lastmod range intersects the window with a +/-7d margin, then extracts URLs. Date = YYYY-MM-DD in the URL path (/2026-09-30/slug/): Observador permalinks embed the publication date, and the JSON-LD datePublished on the page matches the URL date EXACTLY (spot-checked 09-30, 10-10, 10-20 + 2 random days; all pages 3688-8604 chars of text). <lastmod> is EDIT time (one sample had dateModified 5h after datePublished), so it is used only to locate sitemaps, never as the listed date. Dead routes: /wp-json/wp/v2/posts -> 404, /wp/v2/posts -> 200 but returns HTML (REST API disabled), /?rest_route=/wp/v2/posts -> 404. No RSS/AMP/Wayback needed.
